title: Chicken Stew à la Bourguignonne
description: A hearty French-inspired stew made with tender chicken and flavorful vegetables.
instructions: Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken from pot and set aside.
Add carrots, celery, and red bell pepper to pot and cook until vegetables are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add red wine to pot and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add broth, flour, salt, and pepper to pot and stir to combine.
Return chicken to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
